# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/lock

Unlock a previously locked issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-320`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User lacks write permission on issues/pulls
- **404** — Issue not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.UnlockIssue | controller | Get issue by index; Check write permission; Call issues_model.UnlockIssue if currently locked |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | issues_model.UnlockIssue | repository | Set is_locked=false; Update issue column; Create unlock comment in transaction |

### Datastore Operations

| Store | Type | Operation | Description |
|-------|------|-----------|-------------|
| [issue](../datastores/databases.md#issue) | database | SELECT | Get issue by repo and index |
| [issue](../datastores/databases.md#issue) | database | UPDATE | Set is_locked=false |
| [comment](../datastores/databases.md#comment) | database | INSERT | Create unlock comment |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| User must have write permission on issues/pulls to unlock | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |
| Unlock is idempotent - if already unlocked, return success without action | business_logic | issue.IsLocked |

### Error Paths

- **Issue not found** → repo.UnlockIssue → 404
- **No write permission** → repo.UnlockIssue → 403
- **DB error** → repo.UnlockIssue → 500
